verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for an AI model-hosting platform, but the evidence describes no first-party way to operate Replicate itself (running models, deploying, managing predictions) through natural-language commands. Text-prompted image models are hosted model features rather than product control, and llms.txt or docs.md only serve documentation to agents, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
